tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is required on all builds, development builds included; it is not disabled in any build configuration.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
tool_input.description: Write the TLS verification policy file

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says certificate verification is required on all builds, dev builds included, and is not disabled in any configuration.

That statement rests on the later of two recorded user statements. The earlier one said verification was disabled in dev as a workaround. The later one said "Let's not use that workaround - need verification on all builds". I left the retired workaround out of the file.

The later statement is only in the session-episode records, not in the decision catalog. The only nearby catalog decision is #33, "https everywhere, no plaintext exception". That covers plaintext, not certificate verification, so I did not cite it. If you want this policy backed by a formal decision record, it would need to be re-stated as one.
